source.dataset: Hong Kong regional overview from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, 2021 release
source.kind: Fictional story terrain derived from 30m modern DSM. Selected lake and river replaced by synthetic terrain; source remains separately in R01.
source.vertical_datum: EGM2008 (EPSG:3855); no vertical conversion applied; not HKPD
source.array_order: C row-major, row0 north; E=823035.0+col*30; N=845485.0-row*30
source.height_resampling: R01 samples cropped without resampling; explicitly marked fictional lake/river interpolation and small station grading

mask_values.1: Original land plus designated fictional water-removal areas

source.mask_method: Original WBM with only designated water-removal cells converted to fictional land
source.mask_specification: Product Handbook v5.0 page21/Table8 (PDF page index20)
source.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
source.coordinate_usage: X=E-East0, Z=N0-N, Y=source height except documented fictional edits; no vertical exaggeration
limitations: Platform, route and tunnel markers are planning annotations, not engineered geometry

storyWorld.boundaryRule: All directors and writers keep stories inside this bounded world.

stationGrading.method: 100m x 310m core, 30m smooth fringe, eligible original land within 6m of the shared 9m datum only; no large hillside cut and no ocean filling

markupFit.status: approximate fictional design intent, NOT exact georeferencing or engineering alignment
markupFit.bounds_derivation: Inverse-project the red screenshot quadrilateral to original DSM, then select a north-aligned rectangle near side midpoints and trim the west side slightly. Snap inward to original 30m cells. This avoids enlarging to the quadrilateral bounding box.

second.meaning: Second large shed station, yellow circle southwest of the walled-city reference point. Fictional candidate, not surveyed.

shatinNorthwest.meaning: Raw upper circle centre for audit only; not a platform location.

shatinSoutheast.meaning: Raw lower circle centre for audit only; not a platform location.

shatinCore.meaning: Raw two-circle midpoint for audit. Use shatinPlanningAxis for the actual compact station.

shatinPlanningAxis.meaning: One continuous compact fictional station precinct on nearby low-gradient land, using the two circles only for general locality and side-by-side relation. Platform axes are tens of metres apart.

shatinPlatformWest.meaning: Western parallel platform axis, 35m from shared centre.

shatinPlatformEast.meaning: Eastern parallel platform axis, 35m from shared centre.

shatinPlanningAxis.meaning: One continuous compact fictional station precinct on nearby low-gradient land, using the two circles only for general locality and side-by-side relation. Platform axes are tens of metres apart.

stationMarkupEvidence.interpretation: These are broad handwritten circle marks, not exact platform endpoints. Do not bind platforms to the raw circle centres, excavate an 80m knoll, or separate platforms by ~520m.
stationMarkupEvidence.design_note: A modest local fictional grading treatment may support a common planning level; this is not a survey or construction feasibility claim.

markupFit.routeSouthMeaning: Clock tower coast departure from 105055, continuing with latest 105108 second-station and walled-city segment, ending at the south face of Lion Rock. One ~1km sketch gap between the screenshots is joined conceptually.
markupFit.routeNorthMeaning: 104949 blue sketch, south of Sha Tin northward along the river side and around the bay to Tai Po. The last section crosses contemporary water; this is user-authored fictional intent, not real railway.
markupFit.tunnelMeaning: A schematic connection only. Endpoints are picked surface pixels on opposite mountain flanks and do not define tunnel portals, rail elevations, feasibility, or a surveyed path.

route_intent_uncertainty_m.hand_drawn_stroke_interpretation: wide strokes and occlusion make the line a corridor, not exact control points

cautions: The display labels move to avoid collisions. Only corrected label ground-anchor picks initialize the fit; route pixels supply the final dense control.
Original 30m Copernicus DSM elevations include vegetation/buildings and are EGM2008, not bare-earth, not HKPD, not a historical terrain reconstruction.
Station and route coordinates are rounded to 10m only for implementation convenience. Do not infer 10m positional accuracy.
Route pixels are height-draped for recovery only. The fictional track must not inherit mountain surface heights or large river crossings as an engineering claim.

The raw yellow circles are broad locality markers; do not use their ~89m/~8m centre samples as platform elevations. The selected nearby shared station precinct is ~7–12m DSM with a fictional 9m planning level.
The north-aligned crop is a design interpretation of the red screen rectangle. It preserves approximate coverage while reducing area; it is not a unique exact answer.

planningAdjustments.shaTinSite: Common intent region shifted 67m to nearby gentle land; paired platforms 60m apart, not 527m apart.
planningAdjustments.lionRock: Named mountain control used for conceptual under-mountain segment, no rail grade claimed.

excludedWaterBodies.name: 万宜水库（红框图上方水库）
excludedWaterBodies.method: Outside the new story boundary; not loaded or synthesized

detailMetadata.vertical_reference: EGM2008 background with documented fictional edits; CEDD HKPD detail aligned by LandsD2016 + NGA/PROJ EGM2008 model chain
detailMetadata.array_order: C row-major north-to-south west-to-east; E=x0+col*step; N=y0-row*step; x0/y0 are grid NODES not pixel bounds

payloads.mask: gzip base64uint8 sampled from R02 mask nearest node;0ocean1land2inlandwater
payloads.weight: gzip base64uint8 0..255 display contribution from real model-aligned DTM;255fully real detail,1..254synthetic transition,0R02 background

detailMetadata.transition: Source-window outer100m smoothstep(0..1), zero in added outside padding; only source-covered original-land and entirely unchanged R02 background triangles eligible. Protected R02 story terrain always retained.
detailMetadata.background_triangle_topology: NW-SW-NE / NE-SW-SE, identical to R02 map-integration.js; fallback is the exact piecewise planar coarse mesh, not bilinear heights.
detailMetadata.bounds_alignment: Each source window expanded outwards to R02 30m node grid; runtime nodes every5m or2m include all outer edges

state.sourceDatum: EGM2008 source; local heights artistically edited in explicitly marked story water-removal zones
state.seaDatum: display zero in EGM2008; no tidal model
